correctness.rationale: For each integer m≥8 (k=m−4≥4), the graph vertices are nonconsecutive chords and Ind(SG_{2,k}) faces are pairwise-intersecting families. Any such family is a star or a three-edge triangle. The star union U has D2m-equivariant poset equivalence with the complement-cycle chord graph H_m by the source's explicit inverse order-reversing maps p,q (pq=id, qp extensive); all other relative faces are admissible oriented triples. Braun Theorem1.4 supplies reduced homology concentrated in degree2, therefore χ_H2=[T_m]−[E_m]+[V_m]−1. For nonidentity rotations signed fixed chord/triangle counts vanish except order2 chords and order3 triples, yielding b_m=(m³−12m²+35m−6)/6 at identity, m/2−1 on half-turn, m/3−1 on order3, −1 otherwise. Reflections yield odd m trace1, even m j even trace 3−m/2 and odd j trace m/2−3. Independently enumerated every fixed-simplex signed trace for all 74 dihedral elements across m=8,9,10,11 and matched formula. Those finite checks corroborate, not prove, the all-m poset reduction and fixed-set counts. Actual scripts verify_direct.py and verify_cellular.py were examined.

value.rationale: The rational D2m-character is an exact equivariant refinement of Braun's significant nonequivariant wedge theorem across every m≥8. Exceptional order2/order3 rotations and the two even-m reflection classes encode symmetry not recoverable from Betti numbers; the explicit infinite uniform signed-trace identity can support equivariant homology and character decompositions. This is substantively broader than a tiny finite tabulation, while stopping short of integral equivariant homotopy classification.
